description: List every active FAA traffic management event across the National Airspace System in one call: ground stops, Ground Delay Programs, Airspace Flow Programs, arrival and departure delays, airport closures, closure NOTAMs, and deicing. Rows are sorted by severity (closures, ground stops, then GDPs and then AFPs each by average delay, arrival/departure delays by band maximum, closure NOTAMs, deicing) and carry the reason, delay figures, times, and an advisory reference for faa_delays_get_advisory. Use faa_delays_get_airport_status for the full detail of one airport, including its GDP delay profile and runway configuration.

event_types.description: Only these event types: ground_stop, ground_delay_program, airspace_flow_program, arrival_delay, departure_delay, airport_closure, closure_notam, deicing. Also accepts gs, gdp, afp, spelled-out names such as "departure delay", and a comma-separated string; case-insensitive. Omit for every type. countsByType always covers the whole feed.

name: faa_delays_list_active_events

appliedEventTypes.description: The event_types filter as the server normalized it, or every type when omitted.

countsByType.description: Active events per type across the whole feed, counted before the event_types filter so types the filter excluded stay visible. airspace_flow_program is absent when the en-route feed could not be read.

airspace_flow_program.description: Active Airspace Flow Programs; absent when the en-route feed could not be read.

enRouteFeed.description: Whether Airspace Flow Programs were read: ok, unavailable (the en-route feed failed), or format_changed (it returned a format this server does not read).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `feed_unavailable`: NAS Status unreachable, 5xx, an attempt timeout, or an HTML maintenance page, after retries. `upstream_rate_limited`: The FAA returned 429 after retries, or this server's queue to the FAA would wait past 10 s while backing off from an FAA 429. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The 20 s retry budget ran out. `pacer_shed`: This server's own queue to the FAA would wait past 10 s with no FAA 429 backoff in effect. `feed_contract_changed`: The feed path returned 404/410, or a body whose shape this server no longer recognizes. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

events.description: Active events matching event_types, sorted by severity.

advisory.description: Reference to the ATCSCC advisory behind this item, absent when the FAA feed links none. For the full text, call faa_delays_get_advisory with number as advisory_number and date as date.

number.description: ATCSCC advisory number; numbers restart at 1 each UTC day.

url.description: Server-built advisory URL, the page faa_delays_get_advisory reads for this number and date.

afp.description: Airspace Flow Program detail; present only on airspace_flow_program rows.

altitudeCeiling.description: Upper altitude bound as the FAA reports it.

altitudeFloor.description: Lower altitude bound as the FAA reports it.

type.description: Kind of Flow Constrained Area; fca when the FAA names no specific element.

delayProfile.description: Delay trend: average assigned delay for each 15-minute arrival interval of the program.

averageDelayMinutes.description: Average assigned delay per consecutive 15-minute arrival interval, in order.

items.description: Average delay in minutes for one 15-minute arrival interval.

intervalMinutes.description: Length of each interval in minutes; always 15.

startTime.description: UTC ISO start of the first 15-minute interval. The FAA aligns intervals to the quarter hour, so it can precede the program start by up to 14 minutes.

filtersMatchAny.description: true: departs OR arrives filters apply; false: both must match.

headingDirection.description: Direction of flights included, e.g. westbound (FAA-authored).

averageDelayMinutes.description: Average assigned delay in minutes (ground_delay_program, airspace_flow_program).

closureText.description: airport_closure exceptions, or the closure_notam NOTAM text (FAA-authored).

delayRangeMinutes.description: Delay band for arrival_delay and departure_delay (the FAA reports 15-minute bands); absent when the FAA reported neither bound.

max.description: Upper bound in minutes; absent when the FAA reported only the lower bound.

min.description: Lower bound in minutes; absent when the FAA reported only the upper bound.

location.description: FAA airport identifier, or the AFP name for airspace_flow_program (FAA-authored).

probabilityOfExtension.description: Ground stop extension likelihood: low <30 %, medium 30–60 %, high >60 % per the FAA.

programStartTime.description: When a ground_delay_program began, before any revision (UTC ISO); absent on other types.

startTime.description: Start (UTC ISO). For ground_delay_program, the start of the current revision's arrival window; for deicing, when it began.

trend.description: Direction an arrival or departure delay is moving.

fetchedAt.description: When this server fetched the airport events from the FAA (UTC ISO); with the 60 s cache it can trail the call by up to a minute.

notice.description: Guidance on empty or partial results, stale delay entries, and how to get the missing data.

shown.description: Events returned after the event_types filter.

totalActive.description: Every active event read, before the event_types filter; excludes AFPs when the en-route feed could not be read.

title: List Active FAA Delay Events
